days.focus: Character-keyed tree; O(L) prefix lookup.

days.focus: DFS build; abandon a branch on constraint violation.

days.focus: Graph + backtracking recall; then the tree D&C hards.

days.focus: Rolling variables; Kadane family.

days.title: 2-D Dynamic Programming
days.focus: Grid/table tabulation.

days.title: 0/1 Knapsack & Bounded State
days.focus: Subset selection under capacity; coin/word variants.

days.title: LCS / Edit Distance
days.focus: Two-string alignment; match vs transform.

days.title: State Machine DP
days.focus: Named states + transitions; the stock-trading family.

days.title: Consolidation — DP only
days.focus: Re-solve 4 mixed DP problems from Days 22–26, notes closed. DP is where most seniors leak points.

days.title: Revision — Weeks 3–4 (D&C + BST)
days.focus: One full narrated 45-min problem, then clear the D&C / BST set.

days.title: Greedy Exchange Arguments
days.focus: Locally optimal, justified by an exchange argument.

days.title: Bit Manipulation & Bitmasks
days.focus: XOR cancellation, masks, bit tricks.

days.title: Cyclic Sort + In-place Matrix
days.focus: Index-placement in-place; same idea powers matrix mechanics.
days.note: Cyclic Sort proper (Missing Number, First Missing Positive) isn't in Top 150 — add those two.

days.title: Linked List Inversion
days.focus: Re-thread pointers in one pass with a sentinel.

days.title: Binary Tree Divide & Conquer
days.focus: Recurse, combine child summaries, update a global.

days.title: Tree BFS + Dijkstra's
days.focus: Level-order queue walks; Dijkstra is the weighted cousin.
days.note: Dijkstra isn't in Top 150 — do Network Delay Time + Path with Maximum Probability.

days.title: Foundational Capstone
days.focus: 90-min mixed mock (2 problems). Review all 30 trigger notes. Foundations done.

days.title: Segment Tree with Lazy Propagation
days.focus: Range query + range update; write the template twice.
days.note: Beyond Top 150 — Atlas template + Range Sum Query Mutable, then a lazy-prop range-add problem.

days.title: Bitwise XOR Trie
days.focus: Numbers as bit paths; greedy opposite-bit walk.
days.note: Beyond Top 150 — do Maximum XOR of Two Numbers in an Array.

days.title: Bellman-Ford & Bounded Hops
days.focus: Relax edges K+1 times over a snapshot.
days.note: Beyond Top 150 — do Cheapest Flights Within K Stops.

days.title: Tarjan's SCC / Bridges
days.focus: Discovery time + low-link in one DFS.
days.note: Beyond Top 150 — do Critical Connections in a Network.

days.title: Thread-Safe LRU / LFU Cache
days.focus: Hash map + doubly-linked list; add and reason about the lock.

days.title: Token Bucket / Leaky Bucket
days.focus: Timestamp math; burst behaviour under a QPS cap.
days.note: Beyond Top 150 — Design Hit Counter / Logger Rate Limiter, then reason about concurrency.

days.title: Revision — Advanced hardest
days.focus: Re-implement Segment Tree + Tarjan from scratch, no notes.

days.title: Count-Min Sketch
days.focus: Hash rows; min across rows estimates frequency.
days.note: Not a LeetCode problem — implement from the Atlas; test on a token stream.

days.title: HyperLogLog Cardinality
days.focus: Registers of leading-zero runs; harmonic mean.
days.note: Not a LeetCode problem — implement and validate against an exact set count.

days.title: HNSW Vector Graph Indexing
days.focus: Layered greedy descent + base-layer beam search.
days.note: Not a LeetCode problem — study the paper/diagram; sketch build + search.

days.title: Speculative Decoding Verification
days.focus: Draft proposes, target verifies; accept a matching prefix.
days.note: Not a LeetCode problem — understand why accept/reject preserves the target distribution.

days.title: Continuous Batching Scheduler
days.focus: Admit/evict sequences under a KV-cache budget. All 41 done.
days.note: Not a LeetCode problem — sketch the vLLM-style scheduler loop.

days.title: Consolidation — AI-infra
days.focus: Whiteboard-explain each of the 5 aloud as a design-round drill.

days.title: Revision — all 11 advanced
days.focus: Recall every advanced trigger note; re-solve your 3 weakest.

days.title: Recognition set
days.focus: 3 mediums, ~28 min each. Name the pattern before writing any code.

days.title: Timed mock
days.focus: 2 problems × 45 min + honest self-review against a rubric.

days.title: Graph + DP focus mock
days.focus: The two areas that most often decide a senior verdict.

days.title: Systems live-coding mock
days.focus: LRU cache, rate limiter, or segment tree — coded live, explained.

days.title: Full loop simulation
days.focus: Two back-to-back 45-min rounds. Record yourself; watch it back.

days.title: Weak-area repair
days.focus: Re-drill whatever you fumbled on Days 50–54. Targeted, not broad.

days.title: Full loop simulation — round 2
days.focus: Same format. Compare against Day 54; the delta is your progress.

days.title: Hardest problems re-solve
days.focus: Your personal hardest list, from scratch — includes the two Top-150 brutes.

days.title: Speed round — Top-150 fundamentals sweep
days.focus: 8–10 × 15 min. Clears remaining string / hashmap / math basics under a clock.

days.title: Light review
days.focus: One calm pass over all 41 trigger notes. No cramming.

days.title: Final light mock or rest
days.focus: One easy round to stay warm, or rest. You're interview-ready.
